title: Pollen balances and account workflows got more dependable
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: steadier Pollen accounting, cleaner onboarding, better monitoring, and a few useful signs of life around the ecosystem.

Balance tracking now has a local D1-backed record, while the tier-sync tooling was rebuilt around safer user management. Polar caching and pending-spend handling were tuned to keep account updates responsive without repeatedly bothering the upstream API, and app submissions now handle special characters correctly with clearer rejected-tier labeling.

Enter UI buttons were cleaned up, beta-service terms now have their own section, and the React documentation finally states the actual default seed: 42. The universe remains deterministic, at least on paper.

Model Monitor gained a 60-minute aggregation view for a broader read on service behavior, while Donjon.studio joined the games showcase.
